name: MCPM
relevance: Discovers, configures and manages MCP servers and client profiles
notes: Requires Python 3.11+. Select servers and explicitly configure profiles, client integrations, router processes and sharing. Installing the manager does not install or start individual MCP servers.

name: MCPJam Inspector
relevance: Tests and debugs MCP tools, apps, authentication and agent interactions
notes: The published terminal package requires Node 22+; use a current Node 24 runtime for its dependencies. Its executables are inspector and inspector-vite, distinct from the official mcp-inspector CLI. Start the local inspector, connect servers and configure model/authentication providers explicitly.

name: Skillshare CLI
relevance: Synchronizes agent skills, configurations and integrations across coding tools
notes: Uses the macOS/Linux Homebrew CLI formula, distinct from Skillshare App. Initialize sources and choose targets before running sync; synchronization can write agent configuration files. Windows users can follow the separate upstream installer.

name: wcgw
relevance: Provides interactive shell and code-editing tools to MCP coding clients
notes: Requires Python 3.11+; the upstream quick start selects Python 3.12. Supports macOS/Linux; Windows guidance uses WSL. Configure the MCP client separately. Starting the server exposes shell and file operations to the connected client; installation does not start it.

name: Supergateway
relevance: Bridges stdio and HTTP/SSE/WebSocket transports for agent MCP servers
notes: The npm package declares Node 20+; use a current Node runtime for SDK dependencies. Choose commands, URLs, authentication, transport and listener settings explicitly. Installation does not start a gateway.

name: TOON CLI
relevance: Converts JSON to token-oriented notation and analyzes agent context size
notes: Requires Node 24+. The CLI is @toon-format/cli and runs as toon, distinct from the @toon-format/toon library. Choose inputs and conversion/output options explicitly; token statistics depend on the data and tokenizer.

name: RuVector CLI
relevance: Manages persistent vector memory, semantic retrieval and MCP tools for agents
notes: Requires Node 20+ and a working native backend. Published core binaries cover macOS x64/arm64, glibc Linux x64/arm64 and Windows x64; verify ruvector info before relying on persistent storage. Semantic commands download an embedding model on first use. Memory indexing, hooks and MCP startup are separate steps.

name: amux
relevance: Runs parallel coding-agent sessions in a terminal workspace and worktree UI
notes: Uses the upstream Homebrew tap on macOS/Linux; its formula builds from source with Go and depends on tmux. Requires tmux 3.2+ and Git. Install and authenticate agent CLIs separately; workspace creation and agent startup are explicit operations.

name: Firecrawl CLI
relevance: Scrapes, searches and crawls web content for coding-agent context
notes: Requires Node 22+. The published CLI is firecrawl-cli, distinct from the firecrawl SDK. Authenticate with a service account/API key and select requests explicitly; service calls can consume account credits. Installation does not run crawls or provision services.

name: OptiLLM
relevance: Serves an OpenAI-compatible inference proxy with agent tools and reasoning methods
notes: Requires Python 3.10+ and model/backend dependencies; some methods need additional packages or model downloads. The canonical repository is algorithmicsuperintelligence/optillm. Configure providers, inference approaches and listener settings before explicitly starting the proxy.

name: Agent Eval
relevance: Evaluates coding-agent tasks in repeatable Docker or Vercel sandbox experiments
notes: The package declares Node 18+, but dependencies require newer runtimes; use Node 22.19+ or current Node 24. Choose an agent/provider, evaluation project and Docker or Vercel sandbox backend separately. Runs can make model and cloud calls; --dry previews experiments without executing them.

name: garak
relevance: Runs configurable vulnerability and behavior probes against language-model targets
notes: Requires Python 3.11+. Select target generators, probe suites and credentials explicitly. Optional probes/detectors may require further packages, model downloads or hardware. Installation does not run probes.

name: DeepEval
relevance: Runs agent and language-model evaluations with configurable quality metrics
notes: Requires Python 3.9 through 3.x. The deepeval distribution supplies the deepeval CLI. Create evaluation tests and configure providers separately; model-backed metrics can make paid API calls. Hosted account integration is optional and explicit.

name: Snyk Agent Scan
relevance: Discovers and scans agent skills, MCP servers and configurations for risks
notes: Requires Python 3.10+ and Snyk account/token setup. Formerly MCP Scan; use the official snyk-agent-scan Python distribution, not an npm lookalike. Starting a scan can execute configured MCP commands, contact servers and submit component metadata for analysis; review upstream consent and data-handling guidance. Windows discovery coverage varies by agent.

name: Cisco Skill Scanner
relevance: Analyzes agent skills with static, behavioral and optional model-based checks
notes: Requires CPython 3.11 through 3.14. Published wheels include the CEL helper for glibc Linux x64/arm64, macOS 14+ x64/arm64 and Windows x64. Other source builds require Go 1.27.1+. Select skill paths and analyzers explicitly; optional model/hosted analyzers require separate credentials.

name: MCO
relevance: Orchestrates selected coding-agent CLIs for task execution and comparative review
notes: Requires Node 18+ and python3 (Python 3.10+) on PATH. Uses the official @tt-a1i/mco npm wrapper with its bundled Python sources, not the unrelated mco PyPI package. This entry supports macOS/Linux. Install provider CLIs and authenticate them separately; run mco install explicitly for optional skill setup and select providers for each task.

name: Claude Code Log
relevance: Converts coding-agent session transcripts into browsable HTML and Markdown
notes: Requires Python 3.10+. Select transcript files, output paths and optional serving/TUI modes explicitly. Generated artifacts can contain conversation and tool content; review them before sharing.

name: Context Mode
relevance: Provides sandboxed execution and indexed retrieval to reduce agent context volume
notes: Requires Node 22.5+ and a supported better-sqlite3 native build. The upstream npm postinstall can repair existing Claude plugin registry/settings and normalize hooks, including during updates. Configure agent adapters/MCP registration separately; installation does not launch the server. Follow upstream runtime and platform guidance.

name: Claude Replay
relevance: Turns coding-agent JSONL sessions into interactive replay artifacts
notes: Requires Node 18+. Choose session files and generate output explicitly. Review generated replay content before sharing; transcripts can contain prompts, code and tool output.

name: Sentry CLI
relevance: Retrieves debugging context and AI root-cause analysis for coding agents
notes: Requires Node 20+. Uses the sentry npm package from getsentry/toolkit, distinct from @sentry/cli and its sentry-cli executable. Authenticate and select projects explicitly. AI explanation/fix-plan features require service access; installing the CLI does not configure the separate Sentry MCP server.
